title: Couscous with Feta and Olive
subtitle: Herbed couscous with crumbled feta, kalamata olives and cucumber
excerpt: Couscous tossed with crumbled feta, kalamata olives, chopped cucumber and fresh mint, dressed in lemon juice and olive oil. A sharp, salty salad that needs no cooking beyond making the couscous.
sourceNotes: Couscous salads with feta and olives are part of a wider genre of Eastern Mediterranean ingredients applied to the North African staple of couscous. The combination became popular in British cooking from the late 1990s as feta became a mainstream supermarket cheese and Mediterranean salad ingredients moved into the everyday repertoire.

recipe.batchNotes: Keeps for 2 days. Add the feta and olives just before serving if keeping overnight.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the couscous base up to a day ahead; dress and add toppings before serving.

content.text: Couscous with feta and olive takes less than 20 minutes and needs no cooking beyond making the couscous. The feta brings salt and creaminess; the olives bring depth; the cucumber brings freshness and crunch. It is a sharper, lighter salad than the roasted-vegetable version, and works particularly well as a packed lunch or a quick midweek meal alongside grilled lamb.

Put {{couscous}} of couscous in a large bowl. Pour over {{stock-vegetable}} of hot stock, cover with a plate and leave for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Leave to cool for a further 10 minutes, then add the cucumber, red onion, olives, mint and parsley (if using). Drizzle over the lemon juice and {{olive-oil}} of olive oil. Add {{black-pepper}} of black pepper and toss everything together. Scatter the crumbled feta over the top. Do not season with salt; the feta and olives will provide plenty. Taste before adding any extra.

items.cause: Feta, olives and seasoned stock all contribute salt.
items.fix: Do not add extra salt. Taste before seasoning. A squeeze of extra lemon will balance rather than more salt.

items.cause: Cucumber releases water, especially if left to sit.
items.fix: Dice and add the cucumber close to serving. If making ahead, salt and drain the cucumber: toss with a pinch of salt, leave 10 minutes in a sieve, and press dry.

content.text: Feta and olives came to couscous as Eastern Mediterranean ingredients moved into the British kitchen in the 1990s and 2000s. The salad sits between North African grain cooking and Greek mezze. It is quick to make and works at any temperature.
